description: Evaluate the EXACT allocation a scheduler is about to hand out, these nodes, these GPU indices, against what Denpex knows about them: quarantined or repeat-offender cards, split driver versions inside one collective, software combinations that have crashed and never completed, degraded fabric links, an incomplete distributed checkpoint, storage about to hit ENOSPC. Returns GO / GO_WITH_WARNING / REQUIRE_APPROVAL / BLOCK with the evidence for each. Advisory unless `enforce` is true. IMPORTANT: a check Denpex could not evaluate is reported as unknown, never as a pass, read `evidenceCoverage` before treating a GO as an all-clear.

enforce.description: Apply the verdict. Default false, advisory only.

gpus.description: Every GPU the scheduler proposes to allocate.

stack.description: Software the job will run with. Omitting it makes the known-bad-cohort check report unknown.

name: launch_gate

evidenceCoverage.description: Fraction of proposed GPUs Denpex has a record for, 0..1.

title: Gate a job before it lands on a bad GPU
